description: The AI battle report's secondary window (E25): event listening for its re-target channel (wowsp://report-params from the Rust opener), event emission at the main window for playhead seeks (wowsp://report-seek), frameless-titlebar window controls, and the read-only analysis commands the report needs (decision_static_report). State-changing app commands stay label-gated to the main window (audit P0-5): this window creates nothing, writes nothing, only reads analysis.
